text:
**Date:** 14 September 2023, the final race day of the Pallister Cup, when Lucas Wetherby was confirmed at the helm of Seren Aduial.

**Named person and role:** Marguerite Ostrander, Race Director of the Pallister Cup Committee, who verified the crew declarations.

**Figure:** Seren Aduial finished the 212-nautical-mile course in 31 hours 47 minutes, placing third of 18 entries.

**Source document or event:** The Pallister Cup Official Crew Declaration Form (Race Ref. PC-23/09), filed at the Harrowmere Yacht Club registry, which lists Wetherby as skipper.
